rationale: Almost all in-helmet comms earpiece/microphone units had failed on arrival (all but one, per the §2.4 summary of the Crew 15 engineering report). The brief's lesson is to bring spare comms units pre-mission.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.1 Technical failures, lines 524-529, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; also §1.3 line 75 ('spare earpiece/microphone comms units') and §2.4, line 289
